text: Has the course enhanced your knowledge?
Has the course empowered you to take up any known research or job?
Can you create any job with what you have learnt?
Do you see the course with opening or market opportunities in the future?
Can you transfer the knowledge in any phase (e.g teaching, research, community development, etc.) in life?
Was there any dynamic in the teaching?
Does the teaching give time for reflection, distraction and thinking?
Was the study course program designed in such a way you can remember facts?
